```{r setup}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
#| label: load-utils-and-data
source("util_scripts/utils.R")
load('../data/analysis_prep_combined.RData')
```

```{r}
#| label: split-cohorts
#| output: false
df_chop <- df %>% filter(Source == "CHOP")
df_enigma <- df %>% filter(Source == "ENIGMA")
```

## Age Effects

### CHOP

```{r}
#| output: false
#| label: chop-age-interaction-model
cov_str <- " + sex + euler"
rand_str <- ""

mpr_only_cols <- features[grepl("CT",features)]

# dx * age_days interaction term: tests whether the case-control effect on
# deviation scores changes with age.
res <- fit_interaction_model(df_chop, cov_str, features, rand_str = rand_str,
                                  model_type = "zscore", mpr_only_cols = mpr_only_cols)

res_chop <- summarize_model_results(res,"predictor22q11DS:interactor")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: chop-results-summary
print_top_significant_results(res_chop)
summarize_results_by_cortex(res_chop, caption = "Age Interaction Results Grouped by Cortex in CHOP")
```

### ENIGMA

```{r}
#| label: enigma-age-interaction-model
#| output: false
cov_str <- " + sex + euler"
rand_str <- ""

mpr_only_cols <- c()

res <- fit_interaction_model(df_enigma, cov_str, features, rand_str = rand_str, 
                                  model_type = "zscore", mpr_only_cols = mpr_only_cols)

res_enigma <- summarize_model_results(res,"predictor22q11DS:interactor")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: enigma-results-summary
print_top_significant_results(res_enigma)
summarize_results_by_cortex(res_enigma, caption = "Age Interaction Results Grouped by Cortex in ENIGMA")
```

### Generate Plots

```{r}
#| label: set-plot-limits
#| output: false
fill_col <- "Cohens_d"
ci_lo_col <- "Cohens_d_ci_lo"
ci_hi_col <- "Cohens_d_ci_hi"
sig_col  <- "sig"
colorbar_title <- "Cohen's d"
max_lim <- max(ceiling(abs(res_chop$Cohens_d)*10)/10, 
               ceiling(abs(res_enigma$Cohens_d)*10)/10)
plot_lims <- c(-1*max_lim,max_lim)
```

```{r}
#| label: build-effect-plots
#| output: false
p_chop <- assemble_main_figure_layout(res_chop, df_chop, fill_col, color_scheme, plot_lims,
                 plot_type = "zscore", colorbar_title = colorbar_title,sig_col = sig_col,
                 formatted = T, bar_global = T) + figure_theme

p_enigma <- assemble_main_figure_layout(res_enigma, df_enigma, fill_col, color_scheme, plot_lims,
                 plot_type = "zscore", colorbar_title = colorbar_title,sig_col = sig_col,
                 formatted = T, bar_global = T) + figure_theme
```

```{r, fig.width = 8.5, fig.height = 6.5}
#| echo: false
#| label: chop-effect
#| fig-cap: "Differences in global and regional centile score age interaction effects in the CHOP cohort."
p_chop
```

```{r, fig.width = 8.5, fig.height = 6.5}
#| echo: false
#| label: enigma-effect
#| fig-cap: "Differences in global and regional centile score age interaction effects in the ENIGMA Cohort."
p_enigma
```

#### Combine Plots

```{r, fig.width = 6.69, fig.height = 10}
#| label: combine-and-save-figure
#| fig-cap: "Figure S4. Age-by-diagnosis interaction effects on global and regional centile scores of structural MRI metrics in the CHOP and ENIGMA cohorts."
t1 <- ggdraw() + 
  draw_label("CHOP", x = 0.01, hjust = 0, fontface = "bold")
t2 <- ggdraw() + 
  draw_label("ENGIMA", x = 0.01, hjust = 0, fontface = "bold")

caption <- ggdraw() +
              draw_label(glue(' '))

p <- ggarrange(t1, p_chop, t2, p_enigma, nrow = 4, heights = c(0.08,1, 0.08, 1)) + figure_theme
ggarrange(p, caption, heights = c(11.6,0.5), ncol = 1) + figure_theme

dir.create("../figures_final/", showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave("../figures_final/png/figure_s4_age_by_diagnosis.png", bg = 'white')
ggsave("../figures_final/pdf/figure_s4_age_by_diagnosis.pdf", bg = 'white')
```
